name: Gunslinger
description: Gunslinger Films was established in 2009 to serve as an in-house production company to the Revolver Group. The company set out to launch and promote rising talent and to make distinctive feature films that are commercially viable.  Having achieved these objectives Gunslinger is now ideally placed to take the next step in its development, with a view to increasing production values, reaching wider audiences and building on the successful partnership with its parent company – in itself a multi-award winning UK 'All Rights' distributor.  In 2011 this foundation was strengthened with the creation of Revolver RDT Film Partners, to provide equity funding in order to finance future productions. In addition, a partnership was formed with LA based IM Global, now handle international sales across a number of Gunslinger films.
